name: Borken (North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red in the proportions 3:5:3, charged at the top with the city arms of Borken (a red castle on white).
history: By deed of the Bezirksregierung Münster of 22 April 1970 the city was granted the right to bear arms and a flag (banner); the banner is red, white and red 3:5:3 striped lengthwise with the arms on the white stripe.

features.role: Borken arms — red castle on white
